name: Customer Interview Synthesis
summary: Turns raw interview notes or transcripts into themes, quotes and opportunity statements.
description: Clusters observations across interviews into themes, keeps verbatim quotes attached to the interview they came from, and separates what customers said from interpretation. A check rejects any quote that does not appear in the supplied notes.
problems: I have interview notes but no clear takeaways
I need to validate a problem with customers
I want evidence for my product roadmap

inputs.label: Interview notes
inputs.description: Paste notes or transcripts, separated by interview.
inputs.example: Interview 1 (ops lead, 40-person agency): "We reconcile expenses by hand every Friday..."

outputs.label: Themes
outputs.description: Themes with supporting quotes and counts.

steps.name: Cluster themes
steps.responsibility: Group observations into themes and draft opportunities.

steps.name: Verify quotes
steps.responsibility: Confirm every quote appears verbatim in the notes.

criteria.description: All quotes appear verbatim in the input notes.
Each theme states how many interviews support it.
